units: <cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 6:19">Targ. O. Num. VI, 19</cite> (Y. <cite ref="A00454"><he>אֶדְרוֹעָא</he></cite>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Ketubot 65a:9">Keth. 65ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>איגלי דְּרָעָהּ</he> her arm was uncovered; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 80:5">Gen. R. s. 80</cite> <he>שגלה בה דרועה</he>, a corrupt., prob. to be read: <he>שגלתה את זרועה</he>.]—

<cite ref="Yoma 33b:2">Yoma 33ᵇ</cite> <he>עבורי ד׳ וכ׳</he> it is forbidden to forego the arm in favor of the forehead, i.e. to reverse the order of putting on T’fillin (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 6:8">Deut. VI, 8</cite>; oth. interpret. v. Tosaf. a. l.).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 37:17">Targ. Ps. XXXVII, 17</cite> <he>דְּרוֹעֵי</he>.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 22:9">Targ. Job XXII, 9</cite> <he>ודְרָעַת</he> Ms. (ed. <he>אדרעת</he>).
